<script>
import { createComponent, ref, onMounted, computed } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    title: { type: String, value: 'Featured' },
    subtitle: { type: String, value: '' }
  },
  setup (props, context) {
    const items = ref([])
    const loading = ref(false)
    const showToast = ref(false)
    const toastMsg = ref('')
    const showGradient = ref(false)
    const enableItemAnimation = ref(false)

    const bgStyle = computed(() => {
      if (!showGradient.value) return {}
      return {
        backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6b6b, transparent)'
      }
    })

    const animStyle = computed(() => {
      if (!enableItemAnimation.value) return {}
      return {
        transition: 'opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease'
      }
    })

    setTimeout(() => {
      showGradient.value = true
      onMounted(() => {
        initObserver()
      })
    }, 0)

    function initObserver () {
      const observer = context.createIntersectionObserver()
      observer.relativeTo('.card-body .card-item').observe('#load-trigger', (res) => {
        if (res.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          loadMore()
        }
      })
    }

    function loadMore () {
      if (loading.value) return
      loading.value = true
      mpx.request({
        url: '/api/items',
        data: { page: items.value.length / 10 + 1 },
        success (res) {
          items.value = items.value.concat(res.data.list)
          context.nextTick(() => {
            enableItemAnimation.value = true
          })
          loading.value = false
        }
      })
    }

    function handleItemTap (id) {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/detail/index?id=${id}` })
    }

    function hideToast () {
      showToast.value = false
    }

    return {
      items,
      loading,
      showToast,
      toastMsg,
      bgStyle,
      animStyle,
      handleItemTap,
      hideToast
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script>
import { createComponent, ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    title: { type: String, value: 'Featured' },
    subtitle: { type: String, value: '' }
  },
  setup (props, context) {
    const items = ref([])
    const loading = ref(false)
    const showToast = ref(false)
    const toastMsg = ref('')
    const showGradient = ref(false)
    const enableItemAnimation = ref(false)
    let observer = null

    const bgStyle = computed(() => {
      if (!showGradient.value) return {}
      // @mpx-if (mode === 'ios')
      return { backgroundColor: '#ff6b6b' }
      // @mpx-else
      return { backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6b6b, transparent)' }
      // @mpx-endif
    })

    onMounted(() => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        showGradient.value = true
      }, 0)

      // @mpx-if (mode === 'wx')
      initObserver()
      // @mpx-else
      loadMore()
      // @mpx-endif
    })

    onUnmounted(() => {
      if (observer) observer.disconnect()
    })

    function initObserver () {
      observer = context.createIntersectionObserver()
      observer
        .relativeToViewport({ bottom: 100 })
        .observe('#load-trigger', (res) => {
          if (res.intersectionRatio > 0) loadMore()
        })
    }

    function loadMore () {
      if (loading.value) return
      loading.value = true
      mpx.request({
        url: '/api/items',
        data: { page: Math.floor(items.value.length / 10) + 1 },
        success (res) {
          // @mpx-if (mode === 'wx')
          enableItemAnimation.value = false
          // @mpx-endif
          items.value = items.value.concat(res.data.list)
          // @mpx-if (mode === 'wx')
          context.nextTick(() => {
            enableItemAnimation.value = true
          })
          // @mpx-endif
        },
        fail () {
          toastMsg.value = '加载失败，请稍后重试'
          showToast.value = true
        },
        complete () {
          loading.value = false
        }
      })
    }

    function handleItemTap (id) {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/detail/index?id=${id}` })
    }

    function hideToast () {
      showToast.value = false
    }

    return {
      items,
      loading,
      showToast,
      toastMsg,
      bgStyle,
      enableItemAnimation,
      handleItemTap,
      hideToast
    }
  }
})
</script>
